name: Foundation Repair
summary: Foundation repair coordination for residential and light commercial properties, including evaluation, excavation, support systems, drainage considerations and related interior repairs.

faqs.question: What are common signs of foundation problems?
faqs.answer: Common signs include wall or ceiling cracks, sticking doors, uneven floors, separation around windows and visible exterior brick movement.

faqs.question: Does every crack mean foundation failure?
faqs.answer: No. Some cracks are cosmetic or caused by normal movement. A qualified evaluation is needed to determine the cause and appropriate repair.
